dedupe_keys.name: energy meter and bms data of the wilanow town hall building warsaw poland

description: This dataset contains measurements from the building management system of the Wilanów district town hall in Warsaw, Poland, a public administration building used as a demonstration site in the EU HIT2GAP project on closing the gap between designed and actual building energy performance. It was published on Zenodo on 26 September 2019 by Marta Kęsik of the City of Warsaw and Julisz Żach of Mostostal Warszawa, extracted with the open-source BEMServer platform developed in the project. It gives heating energy for the whole building and for the third-floor demonstration area, electricity for the chiller serving one air-handling unit and for the third floor, temperatures, carbon dioxide and humidity in conference rooms served by that unit, and weather data, with a list of variables. Coverage is one building. Access: a 7 MB archive on Zenodo. Licence: Community Data License Agreement, Permissive 1.0; free. Caveats: the measurement period must be read from the files, and only part of the building is sub-metered. Simulation uses are energy model calibration and fault detection for public buildings. Related records: the Bosch Budapest campus data and the LBNL Building 59 dataset.
